note_tweet.text:
PUBLIC APOLOGY TO MR. PRESIDENT, BOLA AHMED TINUBU

In 2023, I campaigned and voted for Atiku Abubakar because I genuinely believed he was the best candidate at the time. Looking back today, that is one decision I am honestly ashamed of.

After testing President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s leadership for almost three years, I have made up my mind to give him another four years.

His economic reforms, the removal of fuel subsidy, efforts to stabilize the Naira, the end of the fuel queues we used to experience, the reduction in ASUU-related disruptions in our universities, NELFUND supporting Nigerian students, the availability of CNG at cheaper prices, and the improvements we are seeing in the fight against insecurity are some of the things I have seen under this administration.

I may not agree with everything the government is doing, but I cannot ignore the progress I believe has been made.

For these reasons, I have decided to correct my 2023 mistake.

In 2027, I will campaign and vote for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

Sometimes, admitting that you made the wrong decision is not weakness. It is maturity.

2023 was Atiku. 2027 is BAT.

#ArewaForAsiwaju #A4A #TinubuSauBiyu

Starting in 2029, shortening the season to a 154-game schedule would create a standard weekly off day benefiting player health, and it would allow the addition of up to 8 more Postseason games by moving to a best-of-seven Division Series format

Beginning in 2027, higher-seeded clubs in the Wild Card and Division Series would select their opponents
